description.value:
Your fingers move faster than the eye can follow. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Sleight of Hand skill, or expertise in it if you're already proficient. As a bonus action, you can make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to plant an item on someone, hide an object on a creature, cut a purse, or lift something from a pocket.
